description.value: Pattison Farms is a small certified organic family farm operating since 1998, now on a 15+ acre site on Dzini Rd in Black Creek, roughly midway between Courtenay and Campbell River on Vancouver Island. Their Farm Stand offers just-picked seasonal vegetables — tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers, lettuces, garlic, squash, chard, and more — grown using traditional hand planting and harvesting methods. Produce also supplies some of the Comox Valley's top restaurants and specialty markets, reflecting the quality touring cyclists can expect at the stand.

address.value: 2124 Dzini Rd, Black Creek, British Columbia V9J 1H1, Canada
